page_title: OSA 1-0 ALM | Osasuna v Almeria 04/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
90+7' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Osasuna have a corner.
90+6' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+1' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Sergio Herrera.
89' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
87' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and it's Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
85' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
84' Almeria couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
82' Here's the change. Jesus Areso leaves the pitch and Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
82' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Juan Cruz (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Pena.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edgar Gonzalez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Arnau Puigmal (Almeria).
77' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
75' It's like he was asking for a caution. Chumi (Almeria) receives a yellow card.
75' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) coming on for Jon Moncayola.
74' Here is a change. Ante Budimir is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Raul (Osasuna).
70' Adrian Embarba goes off the pitch and Lazaro (Almeria) comes on.
70' The attendance for today's match is 20391.
69' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement.
68' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
64' Osasuna string together a series of short passes.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marc Pubill will be replaced by Chumi (Almeria).
60' A precise low pass is received by Iker Munoz (Osasuna), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
57' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
55' A cross from a corner kick by Almeria is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
55' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Almeria get a corner.
52' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
49' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
48' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the ball on and fires in a shot from 25 metres out. Luis Maximiano stops the effort which is headed to the left post.
47' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Sergio Arribas (Almeria) comes off for Alejandro Pozo.
46' Gaizka Garitano has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marko Milovanovic comes on the pitch for Largie Ramazani (Almeria).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

43' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) picks up a long through ball, but Luis Maximiano deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
39' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
38' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
36' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.
33' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle after Iker Munoz (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
29' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) receives a yellow card.
27' 1 - 0 Ante Budimir (Osasuna) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
26' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
26' A quickly taken corner by Almeria.
25' Almeria quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
24' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
22' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
22' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Osasuna take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
21' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
19' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
15' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
14' Problems for Jagoba Arrasate as Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jose Manuel Arnaiz replaces him.
14' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Osasuna are seeing far more of the ball now.
6' Unlucky! A great strike from Chimy Avila (Osasuna) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
4' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
3' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Osasuna will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
